subject: Announcement: new method to use dev version

messages.subject: Announcement: new method to use dev version
parts:
Hi folks,

The git page previously had instructions to use the dev version of ez
via a command that started "library(RCurl);...". It turns out that a
more optimal approach is to use the devtools library, so I have
updated the git page with instructions to achieve this:

https://github.com/mike-lawrence/ez#readme

I have also intentionally broken the older method, so if you have that
code in your scripts you'll have to replace it with the new devtools
approach.

Apologies for any inconvenience.

Cheers,

Mike
